make_dataset: create a dataset from a given path and implementation type like mmap, cached, lazy, raw, or fasta
make_builder: build an IndexedDatasetBuilder or MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder for writing new indexed dataset files from tensors
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from an existing dataset path by reading its index file magic bytes
dataset_exists: check whether an indexed dataset exists at a given path for a specified implementation type
MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder_add_item: add a tensor item to an mmap indexed dataset builder and write its raw bytes to the output file
